suggestions: I'm grateful for the deploy pipeline going green on the first try after three days of flaky tests.
I'm thankful for the mosque speakers carrying the adhan clear across the taman, even through the monsoon static.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that actually taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm thankful for teh tarik that's actually pulled properly, not just poured and stirred.
I'm grateful for the aircon in the office finally getting fixed after two weeks of sweating through standups.
I'm thankful for my dad still asking how work is going, even though he has no idea what a database is.
I'm grateful for the highway clearing up exactly when I thought I'd be late for Jumaat prayers.
I'm thankful for a senior engineer who says 'good question' and actually means it.
I'm grateful for catching the memory leak in staging before the client ever saw it.
I'm thankful for nasi lemak from the mamak that somehow tastes better after a long sprint.
I'm grateful for the payslip landing on time this month, no excuses, no delays.
I'm thankful for a group chat full of old university friends who still remember my birthday.
I'm grateful for the five minutes of actual silence before everyone else in the house wakes up.
I'm thankful for a client who said thank you instead of just closing the ticket.
I'm grateful for the rain starting right after I park the car, not one second before.
